description: Defines an abstract class 'State' for managing state in Spark Streaming's 'mapWithState' operation, including methods for state existence, retrieval, update, removal, and timeout handling, along with an internal implementation class.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Abstract class for managing state in Spark Streaming, with methods for existence check, get, update, remove, timeout status, and option retrieval.

classes.name: StateImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation of the 'State' class, managing state data and flags such as defined, timingOut, updated, and removed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current state; throws exception if not set.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the state with a new value.

methods.name: isTimingOut
methods.description: Checks if the state is timing out.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns the state as an Option, Some if exists, None otherwise.
